en.name: Legionaries
en.text: Durable sword infantry. Holds the front line.
en.detail: Durable sword infantry. Holds the front line. Deploy on an empty tile or upgrade a matching legion to III. 6 / 9 / 12 troops; soldier size stays fixed. Marches from its own tile at battle start.

zh.name: 军团步兵
zh.text: 耐战的持剑步兵，守住军团前线。
zh.detail: 耐战的持剑步兵，守住军团前线。 空格部署，拖到同兵种格升级，最高III级。6 / 9 / 12人，单兵大小不变，开战从原格出阵。

en.name: Spearmen
en.text: Long reach. Hits slow enemies {slow_pct}% for {slow_seconds}s.
en.detail: Long reach. Hits slow enemies {slow_pct}% for {slow_seconds}s. Deploy on an empty tile or upgrade a matching legion to III. 6 / 9 / 12 troops; soldier size stays fixed. Marches from its own tile at battle start.

zh.name: 长矛兵
zh.text: 长距离近战；命中使敌军减速{slow_pct}%，持续{slow_seconds}秒。
zh.detail: 长距离近战；命中使敌军减速{slow_pct}%，持续{slow_seconds}秒。 空格部署，拖到同兵种格升级，最高III级。6 / 9 / 12人，单兵大小不变，开战从原格出阵。

en.name: Shield Guards
en.text: Heavy infantry. Starts each battle with {guard_shield} shield.
en.detail: Heavy infantry. Starts each battle with {guard_shield} shield. Deploy on an empty tile or upgrade a matching legion to III. 6 / 9 / 12 troops; soldier size stays fixed. Marches from its own tile at battle start.

zh.name: 盾卫
zh.text: 重装步兵；每场战斗获得{guard_shield}点护盾。
zh.detail: 重装步兵；每场战斗获得{guard_shield}点护盾。 空格部署，拖到同兵种格升级，最高III级。6 / 9 / 12人，单兵大小不变，开战从原格出阵。

en.name: Cavalry
en.text: Fast cavalry. First strike deals {charge_pct}% extra damage.
en.detail: Fast cavalry. First strike deals {charge_pct}% extra damage. Deploy on an empty tile or upgrade a matching legion to III. 4 / 6 / 8 troops; soldier size stays fixed. Marches from its own tile at battle start.

zh.name: 骑兵
zh.text: 快速冲锋；首次攻击额外造成{charge_pct}%伤害。
zh.detail: 快速冲锋；首次攻击额外造成{charge_pct}%伤害。 空格部署，拖到同兵种格升级，最高III级。4 / 6 / 8人，单兵大小不变，开战从原格出阵。

en.name: Archers
en.text: Ranged support behind the front line.
en.detail: Ranged support behind the front line. Deploy on an empty tile or upgrade a matching legion to III. 6 / 9 / 12 troops; soldier size stays fixed. Marches from its own tile at battle start.

zh.name: 弓箭手
zh.text: 在步兵后方提供远程火力。
zh.detail: 在步兵后方提供远程火力。 空格部署，拖到同兵种格升级，最高III级。6 / 9 / 12人，单兵大小不变，开战从原格出阵。

en.name: Field Hospital
en.text: Heals in battle; adjacent troops gain {hospital_pct}% max health per level.
en.detail: Orthogonal neighboring troops gain {hospital_pct}% max health per hospital level; strongest hospital only. The medic still heals nearby wounded allies during battle.

zh.name: 野战医院
zh.text: 战中治疗；相邻军团每级增加{hospital_pct}%生命上限。
zh.detail: 上下左右相邻军团每级获得{hospital_pct}%生命上限，多个医疗营取最高加成；军医仍在战场治疗范围内的受伤友军。

en.name: Siege Camp
en.text: Upgrade the workshop for more health and firepower.
en.detail: Lean-to → workshop → engineers camp. Upgrades health and firepower. Place on an empty tile or upgrade a matching facility to III.

zh.name: 攻城营
zh.text: 升级装配工棚，提高投石火力与生命。
zh.detail: 简易装配棚 → 攻城工坊 → 工程营；升级提高火力和生命。空格建造，同建筑格升级，最高III级。

en.name: Drill Yard
en.text: Adjacent camps gain {yard_pct}% attack per yard level.
en.detail: Orthogonal neighbors gain {yard_pct}% attack per level. Multiple drill yards use the strongest bonus. Build on an empty tile or upgrade to III.

zh.name: 训练场
zh.text: 每级使上下左右相邻兵营攻击提高{yard_pct}%。
zh.detail: 每级使上下左右相邻军团或攻城营攻击提高{yard_pct}%；多个训练场取最高加成，不叠加。空格建造，同类格升级至III级。

en.name: Sword Drill
en.text: Legionaries gain {training_pct}% attack.
en.detail: Legionaries gain {training_pct}% attack.

zh.name: 剑术训练
zh.text: 军团步兵攻击提高{training_pct}%。
zh.detail: 军团步兵攻击提高{training_pct}%。

en.name: Bow Drill
en.text: Archers gain {training_pct}% attack.
en.detail: Archers gain {training_pct}% attack.

zh.name: 弓术训练
zh.text: 弓兵攻击提高{training_pct}%。
zh.detail: 弓兵攻击提高{training_pct}%。

en.name: Siege Drill
en.text: Catapults gain {training_pct}% attack.
en.detail: Catapults gain {training_pct}% attack.

zh.name: 攻城训练
zh.text: 投石机攻击提高{training_pct}%。
zh.detail: 投石机攻击提高{training_pct}%。

en.name: Iron Wall
en.text: All melee squads start with +{shield_rank} shield.
en.detail: All melee squads start with +{shield_rank} shield.

zh.name: 钢铁壁垒
zh.text: 所有近战小队开战时获得{shield_rank}点护盾。
zh.detail: 所有近战小队开战时获得{shield_rank}点护盾。

en.name: Crossfire
en.text: Archers deal +{crossfire_pct}% damage to foes engaged by your melee.
en.detail: Archers deal +{crossfire_pct}% damage to foes engaged by your melee.

zh.name: 交叉火力
zh.text: 弓兵对正与我方近战交锋的敌军增伤{crossfire_pct}%。
zh.detail: 弓兵对正与我方近战交锋的敌军增伤{crossfire_pct}%。

en.name: Fire Arrows
en.text: Arrows burn targets for {burn_damage} damage/sec for {burn_seconds}s. Refreshes on hit.
en.detail: Arrows burn targets for {burn_damage} damage/sec for {burn_seconds}s. Refreshes on hit.

zh.name: 火焰箭
zh.text: 箭矢点燃目标，每秒{burn_damage}点伤害，持续{burn_seconds}秒；再次命中刷新。
zh.detail: 箭矢点燃目标，每秒{burn_damage}点伤害，持续{burn_seconds}秒；再次命中刷新。

en.name: Pitch Stones
en.text: Catapults deal +{oil_pct}% damage to burning enemies.
en.detail: Catapults deal +{oil_pct}% damage to burning enemies.

zh.name: 燃油投石
zh.text: 投石机对燃烧中的敌军增伤{oil_pct}%。
zh.detail: 投石机对燃烧中的敌军增伤{oil_pct}%。

en.name: Shock Charge
en.text: Cavalry first-strike bonus rises from +{charge_pct}% to +{charge_upgraded_pct}%.
en.detail: Cavalry first-strike bonus rises from +{charge_pct}% to +{charge_upgraded_pct}%.

zh.name: 破阵冲锋
zh.text: 骑兵首次攻击的额外伤害由{charge_pct}%提高至{charge_upgraded_pct}%。
zh.detail: 骑兵首次攻击的额外伤害由{charge_pct}%提高至{charge_upgraded_pct}%。

en.name: Field Medicine
en.text: Medics heal {healing_pct}% more.
en.detail: Medics heal {healing_pct}% more.

zh.name: 战地医疗
zh.text: 军医治疗量提高{healing_pct}%。
zh.detail: 军医治疗量提高{healing_pct}%。

en.name: Blood & Glory
en.text: Enemy defeats give nearby allies {haste_pct}% faster attacks for {haste_seconds}s.
en.detail: Enemy defeats give nearby allies {haste_pct}% faster attacks for {haste_seconds}s.

zh.name: 浴血战吼
zh.text: 击溃敌军后，附近我军攻击速度提高{haste_pct}%，持续{haste_seconds}秒。
zh.detail: 击溃敌军后，附近我军攻击速度提高{haste_pct}%，持续{haste_seconds}秒。

en.name: United Legion
en.text: All squads gain +{diversity_pct}% attack per different troop type (max {diversity_max_pct}%).
en.detail: All squads gain +{diversity_pct}% attack per different troop type (max {diversity_max_pct}%).

zh.name: 联合军团
zh.text: 每拥有一种不同兵种，全军攻击提高{diversity_pct}%，上限{diversity_max_pct}%。
zh.detail: 每拥有一种不同兵种，全军攻击提高{diversity_pct}%，上限{diversity_max_pct}%。

en.name: Pin & Pierce
en.text: Archers and catapults deal +{pinning_pct}% damage to slowed enemies.
en.detail: Archers and catapults deal +{pinning_pct}% damage to slowed enemies.

zh.name: 牵制穿射
zh.text: 弓兵与投石机对被减速的敌军增伤{pinning_pct}%。
zh.detail: 弓兵与投石机对被减速的敌军增伤{pinning_pct}%。

en.name: Hold Fast
en.text: Every allied squad gains {army_shield} shield for the next battle.
en.detail: Every allied squad gains {army_shield} shield for the next battle.

zh.name: 坚守阵线
zh.text: 下一场战斗，所有我军小队获得{army_shield}点护盾。
zh.detail: 下一场战斗，所有我军小队获得{army_shield}点护盾。

en.name: Testudo
en.text: Legionaries take {testudo_damage_pct}% less damage, but move {testudo_speed_pct}% slower.
en.detail: Legionaries take {testudo_damage_pct}% less damage, but move {testudo_speed_pct}% slower.

zh.name: 龟甲阵
zh.text: 下一场战斗，军团步兵减伤{testudo_damage_pct}%，移动速度降低{testudo_speed_pct}%。
zh.detail: 下一场战斗，军团步兵减伤{testudo_damage_pct}%，移动速度降低{testudo_speed_pct}%。

en.name: War Standard
en.text: All squads gain {rally_pct}% attack for the next battle.
en.detail: All squads gain {rally_pct}% attack for the next battle.

zh.name: 军团战旗
zh.text: 下一场战斗，全军攻击提高{rally_pct}%。
zh.detail: 下一场战斗，全军攻击提高{rally_pct}%。

en.name: Rapid Volley
en.text: Archers and catapults attack {volley_pct}% faster next battle.
en.detail: Archers and catapults attack {volley_pct}% faster next battle.

zh.name: 急速齐射
zh.text: 下一场战斗，弓兵和投石机攻击速度提高{volley_pct}%。
zh.detail: 下一场战斗，弓兵和投石机攻击速度提高{volley_pct}%。
